title: Brand Services Director
description: Job Title: Brand Services DirectorExperience: 3 yrs + Role OverviewWe are seeking a visionary who can create and implement a robust integrated roadmap for our clients, particularly those with traditionally offline brands. This individual will bring a fresh perspective, demonstrating the power of digital marketing beyond just social media and collaborations. The ideal candidate will be a strategic thinker who can drive content strategies and collaborative approaches, ultimately enhancing customer journeys and converting engagement into tangible results. Key Responsibilities • Build comprehensive integrated roadmaps tailored to each client's brand, focusing on transforming traditional marketing approaches to digital-first strategies. • Educate clients on the power and potential of digital marketing, moving beyond basic social media tactics to comprehensive digital content and collaboration strategies. • Develop and implement creative content strategies that align with clients' brand goals and drive engagement. • Foster collaborative efforts between brands and digital influencers, media, and other stakeholders to enhance brand visibility and reach. • Analyse and map out customer journeys, identifying key touchpoints and opportunities for digital engagement. • Develop strategies to enhance customer experiences and drive conversions through personalized and targeted digital interactions. • Work closely with business operations to understand and address customer and brand challenges. • Apply creative problem-solving skills to develop innovative digital solutions that support brand building and customer retention. • Collaborate with various departments, to ensure cohesive and effective digital strategies. • Lead and mentor a team of account managers, fostering a culture of creativity and digital innovation. • Set clear KPIs and objectives for integrated campaigns and initiatives. • Regularly analyse and report on the performance of digital strategies, providing insights and recommendations for continuous improvement. Qualifications• Proven experience in integrated marketing and account management, with a strong understanding of both traditional and digital marketing landscapes. • Strong creative and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to translate complex ideas into actionable strategies. • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and clients. • A deep understanding of customer journeys, digital content strategies, and brand building. • Innovative mindset with a passion for leveraging digital technologies to solve business challenges. Key Attributes• Visionary thinker.• Creative and strategically fertile, capable of generating innovative ideas and solutions. • Strong advocate for the power of digital marketing. • Results-oriented with a focus on driving customer engagement and brand growth. If you are a dynamic and creative integrated marketing professional with a passion for transforming brands and driving digital success, we would love to hear from you. Join us and lead the charge in revolutionizing our clients' landscapes.
